compatibility.title: Kamera yang sudah diuji
compatibility.intro: Diuji dengan kamera asli. Model LUMIX, Canon, dan Nikon lain kemungkinan besar jalan, tapi belum dijamin; Sony dan Fujifilm bergantung pada daftar model SDK pabrikannya. Coba dulu selama masa coba 500 foto.
rows: Didukung, belum diuji dengan kamera asli
Didukung lewat mode PC Remote, belum diuji dengan kamera asli. Foto yang dijepret selagi kabel lepas tidak diambil (kecuali beberapa model baru di macOS)
Didukung di macOS & Windows untuk model SDK Fujifilm (X-H2/H2S, X-T5/T4/T3, X-S20/S10, X-M5, X-Pro3, GFX), belum diuji · Android belum didukung · foto selagi kabel lepas tidak diambil
OM System / Olympus, Pentax / Ricoh, Leica, Sigma belum bisa lewat kabel — pakai Auto Resize dengan folder kartu memori

requirements.intro: Cek dulu sebelum membeli — atau coba dulu 500 foto gratis untuk memastikan Fotolane jalan di perangkatmu.

notes.title: Mac
notes.text: macOS 12 ke atas, Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4, …). Mac Intel belum didukung — cek di menu Apple → About This Mac: harus tertulis “Chip Apple M…”, bukan “Processor Intel”.

notes.title: Android
notes.text: Android 7.0 ke atas, 64-bit (hampir semua HP / tablet sejak 2017). Kamera USB butuh dukungan USB OTG dan kabel USB-C data maksimal 1 m.

notes.title: Prosesor & RAM
notes.text: Disarankan 4 core dan RAM 8 GB. Laptop 2 core (mis. Celeron / Pentium / Athlon) tetap bisa, hanya lebih lambat.

notes.title: Penyimpanan
notes.text: Sekitar 1 GB untuk app, ditambah ruang untuk foto — hasil kompresi hanya ±2% dari ukuran aslinya.

notes.title: Kamera USB
notes.text: Pakai kabel data (bukan kabel khusus mengisi daya) dan matikan Wi-Fi kamera. Sambungan sering putus? Colok ulang kabel dengan mantap, coba port lain atau tanpa hub, atau ganti kabel; bila tetap gagal, cabut-pasang baterai kamera. Lihat daftar kamera teruji di atas.

items: Jendela Aktifkan lebih sederhana: tekan “Buka halaman beli”, bayar dengan QRIS di web, lalu tempel kunci dari halaman pembayaran atau email kuitansi.
Perangkat kedua tetap gratis: daftarkan kode perangkatnya di halaman pembayaranmu (tautannya ada di email kuitansi).
Ada pertanyaan sebelum membeli? Tekan “Tanya lewat email”.
Lisensi yang sudah aktif tetap berlaku seperti biasa.

Kalau Fotolane tertutup tidak normal, atau macet lalu ditutup, saat dibuka lagi Fotolane menawarkan mengirim laporan supaya bisa kami perbaiki. Laporan hanya terkirim kalau kamu setuju, isinya bisa dilihat dulu, dan foto tidak ikut terkirim.
Jendela Aktifkan menampilkan harga terbaru, termasuk sisa kuota harga perkenalan.
Siap untuk pembelian online di apps.labstory.id: kode perangkat langsung terisi, kunci dikirim ke email.
Email berisi kunci untuk dua perangkat bisa ditempel utuh; Fotolane memakai kunci untuk perangkat ini.
Mac: Cmd+Q menanyakan dulu kalau proses masih berjalan, dan melepas kamera dengan rapi.
Lebih ringan di laptop 2 core (mis. AMD Athlon, Intel Celeron / Pentium): proses foto tidak lagi membuat app “Not Responding”.
Kalau app tertutup karena error, penyebabnya dicatat di folder log supaya bisa ditelusuri.
Aktivasi lewat email kini ke hello@labstory.id.

compatibility.title: Tested cameras
compatibility.intro: Tested with real cameras. Other LUMIX, Canon and Nikon models will most likely work, but that isn’t guaranteed; Sony and Fujifilm depend on the manufacturer’s SDK model list. Try it first with the 500-photo trial.
rows: Supported, not yet tested with a real camera
Supported through PC Remote mode, not yet tested with a real camera. Photos taken while the cable is unplugged are not imported (except some newer models on macOS)

Supported on macOS & Windows for Fujifilm SDK models (X-H2/H2S, X-T5/T4/T3, X-S20/S10, X-M5, X-Pro3, GFX), not yet tested · Android not supported yet · photos taken while the cable is unplugged are not imported
OM System / Olympus, Pentax / Ricoh, Leica and Sigma can’t connect by cable yet — use Auto Resize with the memory card folder

requirements.intro: Check before you buy — or try 500 photos free to make sure Fotolane runs on your device.

notes.title: Mac
notes.text: macOS 12 or later, Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4, …). Intel Macs are not supported yet — check Apple menu → About This Mac: it must say “Chip Apple M…”, not “Processor Intel”.

notes.title: Android
notes.text: Android 7.0 or later, 64-bit (almost every phone/tablet since 2017). The USB camera feature needs USB OTG support and a USB-C data cable of 1 m at most.

notes.title: Processor & RAM
notes.text: 4 cores and 8 GB RAM recommended. 2-core laptops (e.g. Celeron / Pentium / Athlon) still work, just more slowly.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: About 1 GB for the app, plus room for photos — compressed results are only about 2% of the originals.

notes.title: USB camera
notes.text: Use a data cable (not a charge-only cable) and turn off the camera’s Wi-Fi. Connection keeps dropping? Re-plug the cable firmly, try another port or no hub, or another cable; if it still fails, take the camera battery out and back in. See the tested cameras above.

items: A simpler Activate window: press “Open purchase page”, pay with QRIS on the web, then paste the key from the payment page or the receipt email.
The second device is still free: register its device code on your payment page (the link is in the receipt email).
Questions before buying? Press “Ask by email”.
Licenses that are already active keep working as usual.

If Fotolane closed abnormally, or froze and was closed, it offers to send a report when reopened so we can fix it. Reports are only sent if you agree, you can see the contents first, and no photos are included.
The Activate window shows the latest price, including the remaining introductory-price quota.
Ready for online purchase at apps.labstory.id: the device code is filled in for you and the key is sent by email.
An email with keys for two devices can be pasted whole; Fotolane uses the key for this device.
Mac: Cmd+Q asks first if a job is still running, and releases the camera cleanly.
Lighter on 2-core laptops (e.g. AMD Athlon, Intel Celeron / Pentium): photo processing no longer makes the app “Not Responding”.
If the app closes because of an error, the cause is written to the log folder so it can be traced.
Email activation now goes to hello@labstory.id.
